title: Custom Sunrise
description: Original native GPU reconstruction of Custom Sunrise.
notes: Original analytic radial reconstruction with all seven controls, integrated radial speed, three-color sequence and reference 400-pixel radius. This is not pixel-perfect: it models dense bands rather than the finite 400-ring array, so its startup overlap, sparse-ring recycling and historical band colors after Scale edits differ. Scale edits reshape existing bands immediately; the reference retains each ring birth color. No original source or assets are embedded.
